title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produces proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture [pdf]
summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra model reportedly produces a proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture, a long-standing open problem in graph theory stating that every bridgeless graph has a collection of cycles covering each edge exactly twice. The claim gained significant attention on Hacker News with 450+ points and 363 comments, though the validity of the proof remains under community scrutiny.
problem_solved: Attempts to solve the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture, a decades-old unsolved problem in graph theory that relates to covering edges of bridgeless graphs with cycles.
why_valuable: If verified, this would represent a historic achievement—demonstrating an AI system solving a major open mathematical problem that has challenged human mathematicians for over 40 years.
